subject: The one meeting hack I never share publicly
preview_text: This is what separates the organized from the overwhelmed. Only for actual users - not on social media.
body_paragraphs: I was in a board meeting last week where someone asked a question that changed everything. The CEO turned to me and said 'What did we decide about that last month?' Everyone froze. Except me.

I'm only telling you this because you actually use Smart Notes. On social media, I talk about features. With users, I share what actually works. The secret isn't just capturing meetings - it's how you review them. Most people treat notes like archives. The organized treat them like living documents.

That CEO moment? I tapped 'Smart Search' and found the exact decision from 3 meetings ago in 2 seconds. The feature everyone skips because it seems boring. But it's why some users save 5+ hours weekly while others just collect notes.

Open the app right now and search for a keyword from any past meeting. See what surfaces. You'll realize your notes aren't just records - they're your institutional memory. P.S. The real power move? Search for 'action items' and watch every commitment you've ever made appear. Scary. Useful.
